payload.entry: Implemented agent_hijack::execution in sase-core: effective-target precedence (explicit override wins, then prompt %model, then stalled; provider inheritance + effort retention; pool aliases refuse), held-prepare vs resolving-dispatch validation (exact reservation owner, stored-attempt and availability checks, no menu use), pure confirm (settle only on identity/model/workspace/lineage/versioned-ack match, no in-flight request) and safe-rollback (return_to_held only on verified dead child + restored custody + non-dispatchable request) decisions, plus BootstrapAck and AdmissionDescriptor wires. Registered 5 PyO3 bindings with round-trip tests. sase repo untouched (Python adapters deferred to later phases after host ratchets sase-core-revision.txt). Verification: 18 new core unit tests + execution_bindings_round_trip pass; sase tool run check in sase-core VERDICT pass (run fc75f375f16d8435c97170c5d6e4e2bc).

Implementation complete: new tests/test_agent_hijack_recovery_transaction.py composes the full production transaction with real file-backed ledger CAS (Rust transitions), real Python/Rust preview, real continuation preparation and pinned-target validation, real durable admission persistence (typed store plus journal), the real strict child bootstrap gate, and real settlement — replacing only the provider/process boundary (in-process fake provider after the real ack) plus three fixture-world inputs (fixed reserved member acme--4 since no live session exists, enabled-provider availability since the host disable file is not fixture state, pinned model ladder). Eleven tests pass: continue/escalate/edited-explicit-instruct launches with exact model/effort, one-request-one-child concurrency, crash-after-CAS resume re-dispatching the same attempt once, uncertain spawn plus cancel retaining resolving, disabled-provider refusal before dispatch, failed inheritance never reaching the provider, failed termination retaining resolving, and interrupted-settlement replay repairing only done.json. Verified: 11/11 new tests plus 126 focused recovery/admission/bootstrap tests pass; marker-path audit now passes via the new read-only review for recover_confirm._read_successor_meta (five earlier sites were already reviewed; sase-1by audit is fixed). Epic-symbols: build_bootstrap_ack is now private (_build_bootstrap_ack, only require/enforce construct in production) so its row is dropped; BootstrapObservation and RecoveryBootstrapError are re-keyed to still-open parent epic sase-1qz.6.1.4.1 (no correct production caller exists by design — settlement observes via read_recovery_ack and the runner records the typed stop generically). ToolRun 200bd579c232bffb74b1fab7a320a330: all lint gates pass (ruff, mypy, symvision, keep-sorted), 60204 passed, 18 skipped, 2 pre-existing failures, verdict no_new_failures; follow-up recorded above.
